summary: Verified Hot Now UI/UX changes: persona & category pills removed from Hot Now cards, Back Story button + bottom-sheet modal work correctly, Regenerate feels instant (~90ms to first card), TappableText removed from Feed insight body. Backend SSE endpoint /api/insights/hot/stream serves newsroom cards with topic/headline/text populated. All 10 requested checks passed.

minor.issue: Query param `fresh` is typed as int on the backend, so ?fresh=false returns 422. Frontend never sends 'false' (it sends '1' or omits), so no user impact, but the endpoint is inconsistent with common bool query semantics.

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove unused `TappableText` import in /app/frontend/src/pages/Feed.jsx (line 37) and the now-dead handleWordTap / openExplainForPhrase paths and onWordTap prop plumbing — single-tap 'go deeper' is gone from UI but dead code remains.
Optional: accept `fresh=true|false|1|0` on /api/insights/hot/stream instead of strict int to be robust.
critical_code_review_comments: Feed.jsx no longer wraps insight body in <TappableText>, but the import and the handleWordTap/openExplainForPhrase code (~lines 285-405) are dead code. Should be removed for clarity and to prevent regression.
HotFeed.jsx still defines CATEGORY_ACCENT constant that is no longer used after category pill removal — safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hot Now landing page (428x900 mobile) verified: no persona pill, no category pill, Back Story button opens bottom-sheet modal with topic/headline/insight/source/close, modal closes correctly, regenerate returns first card in ~0.09s from newsroom cache with shuffled deck order. SSE endpoint requires ?fresh=1 (int) not fresh=true. Newsroom cache had 13 cards. Feed.jsx line 1152 uses plain {fittedText} — TappableText no longer wraps the insight body. Dead imports/functions remain but do not affect behavior.
